sentences.en: Traveling Salesman and The Return is a little two-episode arc that we did as part of the working out of the merger of the two branches stories.

sentences.en: And we liked the idea that Dwight, as the hometown favorite, gets to have a really strong and romantic arc here.

sentences.zh: 有很多镜头切回他们开车回邓德·米夫林的路上。

sentences.en: And Stanley is just like, can't believe.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利简直就是，不敢相信。

sentences.en: He's so delighted by how that went.
sentences.zh: 他对自己刚才的表现感到非常满意。

sentences.en: He's so tickled.
sentences.zh: 他乐坏了。

sentences.en: It clearly made his day.
sentences.zh: 这显然让他开心了一整天。

sentences.en: I don't know that Stanley gets much joy out of working at Dunder Mifflin, but this was a real highlight for him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道斯坦利在邓德·米夫林工作能获得多少乐趣，但这对他来说确实是个高光时刻。

sentences.en: And there's this moment that Leslie talks about in the DVD.
sentences.zh: 莱斯利在DVD里提到了这样一个瞬间。

sentences.en: He said in the script, it was just that Stanley is driving and laughing, and they just kind of let him go.
sentences.zh: 他说剧本里原本只是写斯坦利在开车时大笑，然后他们就让他自由发挥了。

sentences.en: And he improvised the whole thing about, hi, hi, you sounded like my six-month-old niece.
sentences.zh: 他即兴发挥了整段内容，比如“嗨，嗨，你听起来像我六个月大的侄女”。

sentences.en: And like all of that, Leslie was just riffing.
sentences.zh: 所有这些，都是莱斯利即兴创作的。

sentences.en: Oh, that was so good.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太棒了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And he said, in fact, whenever Stanley would go off on Ryan, as he has throughout the show, they would just let Leslie just go.
sentences.zh: 他说，事实上，每当斯坦利像剧中那样训斥瑞安时，他们都会让莱斯利自由发挥。

sentences.en: And I think there's some amazing moments.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这其中有一些非常精彩的瞬间。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, you know, and this is Ryan's second sales call now that has not gone well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，这是瑞安第二次销售拜访，结果都不太顺利。

sentences.en: Remember, he went on the initiation sales call with Dwight.
sentences.zh: 记得吗，他之前和德怀特一起去过那次入职销售拜访。

sentences.en: They did not make the sale.
sentences.zh: 他们没谈成那笔生意。

sentences.en: And now he's gone out on this call with Stanley.
sentences.zh: 现在他又和斯坦利一起去拜访了。

sentences.en: Now, I believe Stanley's going to save this sale.
sentences.zh: 现在，我相信斯坦利会挽救这笔生意。

sentences.en: Oh, Stanley for sure saved it.
sentences.zh: 噢，斯坦利肯定挽救了它。

sentences.en: Okay, so while all of these sales meetings are happening, Pam and Angela are at the coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 好的，就在这些销售会议进行的同时，帕姆和安吉拉在咖啡店。

sentences.en: Angela is in such a great mood, and she's telling Pam a story about how she had this friend who was in need, and this gallant man came to her rescue.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉心情非常好，她正在给帕姆讲一个故事，说她有个朋友遇到了困难，然后一位英勇的男士挺身而出救了她。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: She's like, he must really care for her a lot because he did this wonderful thing for my friend.
sentences.zh: 她说，他一定非常关心她，因为他为我的朋友做了这件美妙的事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: She's talking in code.
sentences.zh: 她在用暗语说话。

sentences.en: She's speaking in code.
sentences.zh: 她在说暗语。

sentences.en: She's like, my friend, let's call her Noel.
sentences.zh: 她说，我的朋友，我们就叫她诺埃尔吧。

sentences.en: And this gallant gentleman, we'll call him Kurt.
sentences.zh: 而这位英勇的绅士，我们就叫他库尔特吧。

sentences.en: Well, we all know that Kurt is Dwight's middle name, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们都知道库尔特是德怀特的中间名，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we got a lot of fan questions about this, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们收到了很多粉丝关于这个问题的提问。

sentences.en: Kenzie B., Elizabeth R., Julia Lee, Nicole Fink, and Katie Krull all want to know, when Angela refers to her friend Noel, is that because Noel is Angela's middle name?
sentences.zh: 肯齐·B、伊丽莎白·R、朱莉娅·李、妮可·芬克和凯蒂·克鲁尔都想知道，当安吉拉提到她的朋友诺埃尔时，是因为诺埃尔是安吉拉的中间名吗？

sentences.en: It definitely sounds like a very Angela's middle name.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实非常像安吉拉的中间名。

sentences.en: Well, yes, it is Angela's middle name.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，那确实是安吉拉的中间名。

sentences.en: Angela thinks she's being really savvy, but Pam totally knows who she's talking about.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉以为自己很聪明，但帕姆完全知道她在说谁。

sentences.en: But, yes, that is her middle name.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，那确实是她的中间名。

sentences.en: But, Jenna, I have a question for you.
sentences.zh: 但是，珍娜，我有个问题想问你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Is Noel in the script?
sentences.zh: 剧本里写的是诺埃尔吗？

sentences.en: Because I have a little story about that middle name, and I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 因为关于那个中间名我有个小故事，我很好奇。

sentences.en: I think what was in the script was Colette.
sentences.zh: 我想剧本里写的是科莱特。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I looked this up, and in the script, Angela actually says this.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下，在剧本里，安吉拉实际上是这么说的。

sentences.en: She says, well, a friend of mine, let's just call her, oh, let's just call her me.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，我有个朋友，我们就叫她，噢，我们就叫她我吧。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And then you giggle.
sentences.zh: 然后你就咯咯笑了。

sentences.en: Okay, so my memory of this is when we were shooting it that day, that the writers were pitching me different middle names, like different things to say.
sentences.zh: 好的，我对那天的拍摄记忆是，编剧们当时在向我提议不同的中间名，比如让我说不同的名字。

sentences.en: I know in one of them it was Colette.
sentences.zh: 我知道其中一个版本是科莱特。

sentences.en: I have such a memory of saying that.
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得我说过那个名字。

sentences.en: And then we said Noel.
sentences.zh: 然后我们说了诺埃尔（Noel）。

sentences.en: And I like Noel the best because it sounds very sort of Angela Martin, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢诺埃尔这个名字，因为它听起来很有安吉拉·马丁的感觉，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's her love of Christmas, her love of the story of Christmas, that Noel would be her middle name, and that's the one we went with.
sentences.zh: 正是因为她对圣诞节的热爱，对圣诞故事的热爱，诺埃尔才成了她的中间名，我们最终选定了这个。

sentences.en: And Dave Rogers talks about it in the DVD commentary, and he goes, I remember it being Colette, and he thought maybe I improvised Noel, but I didn't.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·罗杰斯在DVD评论音轨里也提到了，他说记得当时是科莱特（Colette），他以为可能是我即兴发挥改成了诺埃尔，但其实不是。

sentences.en: That was a writer's pitch.
sentences.zh: 那是编剧提议的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think I was part of the dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得我参与了对话。

sentences.en: I think we were pitching names, but that all sort of happened in the moment.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时在商量名字，但那都是即兴发生的。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个名字。

sentences.en: It's perfect.
sentences.zh: 太完美了。

sentences.en: It is such an Angela Noel Martin, and I believe that will appear on your wedding invitation.
sentences.zh: 这名字简直就是安吉拉·诺埃尔·马丁，我相信它会出现在你的结婚请柬上。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: It's now part of my character's show Bible.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经成为我角色背景设定的一部分了。

sentences.en: We had another fan catch in this scene, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，这一幕里还有另一个粉丝发现的细节。

sentences.en: Sarah Rouse wrote in to say, Pam is holding a piece of paper at the coffee shop.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·劳斯来信说，帕姆在咖啡店里拿着一张纸。

sentences.en: What is that supposed to be, and what does it say?
sentences.zh: 那是什么东西，上面写了什么？

sentences.en: Well, Sarah, that was the list of coffee orders.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莎拉，那是咖啡订单列表。

sentences.en: From those deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 来自那些被删减的片段。

sentences.en: I had all the coffee orders written down on that piece of paper, and I was going to use it to make my order.
sentences.zh: 我把所有的咖啡订单都写在那张纸上了，我打算照着它去点单。

sentences.en: Well, Angela, also in this scene, just because we were talking about it earlier, your flower hairdo is on full display.
sentences.zh: 嗯，安吉拉，同样是在这一幕里，既然我们刚才提到了，你的花朵发型可是完全展示出来了。

sentences.en: Okay, just if you really want some great shots of it, guys, here it is, her WTF hairdo right here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你们真的想看它的特写，伙计们，就在这儿，她那个“搞什么鬼”的发型。

sentences.en: WTF.
sentences.zh: 搞什么鬼。

sentences.en: Well, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等。

sentences.en: I have something to share.
sentences.zh: 我有东西要分享。

sentences.en: So, while we were on a break, I had been texting Kim Ferry about this hair, and she texted back, and so this is what she had to say about it.
sentences.zh: 刚才休息的时候，我一直在给金·费里发短信讨论这个发型，她回信了，这就是她对此的说法。

sentences.en: I said, Kim.
sentences.zh: 我说，金。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, it's a real-time tidbit.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这是实时的花絮。

sentences.en: It's a real-time tidbit.
sentences.zh: 这是实时的花絮。

sentences.en: It just came in a few minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 几分钟前刚收到的。

sentences.en: So, I said, Kim, what was the inspiration for this bun?
sentences.zh: 所以我问，金，这个发髻的灵感是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I know that we thought my character was going to, like, be in a great mood, and so we wanted to try something new.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道我们当时觉得我的角色心情应该很好，所以想尝试点新鲜的。

sentences.en: She said, yes, here is the inspiration.
sentences.zh: 她说，没错，灵感来源如下。

sentences.en: She said, my first job in the business was working on a sci-fi show called Babylon 5.
sentences.zh: 她说，我入行后的第一份工作是在一部叫《巴比伦5号》的科幻剧组。

sentences.en: I worked on this show for five years, and I couldn't use any contemporary hairstyles because they wanted the hairstyles to look futuristic.
sentences.zh: 我在那部剧工作了五年，我不能用任何现代发型，因为他们要求发型看起来有未来感。

sentences.en: So, I started coming up with all these different kind of braids and buns with wires and fancy updos and Zulu knots, basically anything different that I could think of.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始设计各种各样的编发和发髻，用上发丝、花哨的盘发和祖鲁结，基本上任何我能想到的不同设计。

sentences.en: And your bun with those fun swirls was a good one for me because I had done it on Babylon 5.
sentences.zh: 你那个带有有趣旋涡的发髻对我来说很顺手，因为我在《巴比伦5号》里做过。

sentences.en: It's fast and easy, but technically, this is a sci-fi hairstyle.
sentences.zh: 它又快又简单，但从技术上讲，这是一款科幻发型。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Isn't that great?
sentences.zh: 这不是很棒吗？

sentences.en: Don't you feel like Dwight would have loved it because he was Mr. Sci-Fi?
sentences.zh: 你不觉得德怀特会很喜欢吗？因为他可是科幻迷先生。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, no wonder she did her hair in this Babylon 5 hairstyle.
sentences.zh: 没错，难怪她弄了这个《巴比伦5号》的发型。

sentences.en: To thank Dwight for his, like, favor.
sentences.zh: 为了感谢德怀特帮了她忙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, yes, this hairstyle inspired by Babylon 5.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，这个发型灵感来自《巴比伦5号》。

sentences.en: It's the sci-fi bun.
sentences.zh: 这就是科幻发髻。

sentences.en: I don't think I could love that more.
sentences.zh: 我想我再也不会比现在更喜欢它了。

sentences.en: Kim Ferry, thank you for the real-time tidbit.
sentences.zh: 金·费里，谢谢你提供的实时花絮。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kim Ferry.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，金·费里。

sentences.en: Sam just wrote, beats, bears, Babylon 5.
sentences.zh: 萨姆刚发来消息说：甜菜、熊、巴比伦5号。

sentences.en: Beats, oh, wait, here we go.
sentences.zh: 甜菜，噢，等等，开始了。

sentences.en: Bears, beats, Babylon 5 buns.
sentences.zh: 熊、甜菜、《巴比伦5号》小圆面包。

sentences.en: Oh, okay, so now everybody is coming back from their sales calls.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，现在大家都从销售拜访回来了。

sentences.en: Everyone's done.
sentences.zh: 大家都忙完了。

sentences.en: And we have this amazing scene in the car with Karen and Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 我们有一场凯伦和菲利斯在车里的精彩戏份。

sentences.en: Phyllis is so good in this scene because, you guys, she is going to reveal such a big plot point,
sentences.zh: 菲利斯在这场戏里表现得太棒了，伙计们，她即将揭露一个重大的剧情点，

sentences.en: and she just throws it away, right?
sentences.zh: 而她就那么轻描淡写地说了出来，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not, like, belabored in any way.
sentences.zh: 一点也不拖泥带水。

sentences.en: It's so perfect.
sentences.zh: 太完美了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She's like, Karen, I had a lot of fun with you today.
sentences.zh: 她说，凯伦，我今天和你在一起玩得很开心。

sentences.en: I really enjoy spending time with you.
sentences.zh: 我很享受和你在一起的时光。

sentences.en: They're bonding.
sentences.zh: 她们在建立感情。

sentences.en: They feel good.
sentences.zh: 她们感觉很好。

sentences.en: And then she just very offhandedly says, and I'm really glad you're with Jim.
sentences.zh: 然后她非常随口地说，我真高兴你和吉姆在一起。

sentences.en: It makes me really happy because, you know, he was really hung up on Pam for such a long time.
sentences.zh: 这让我很高兴，因为你知道，他曾对帕姆念念不忘那么久。

sentences.en: And she's not even looking at Karen.
sentences.zh: 而且她甚至都没看凯伦。

sentences.en: She's looking in a rearview mirror.
sentences.zh: 她在看后视镜。

sentences.en: She's turning.
sentences.zh: 她在转弯。

sentences.en: She's just driving.
sentences.zh: 她只是在开车。

sentences.en: She's sort of saying something off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 她就像是随口说了一句什么。

sentences.en: And it's that much more powerful.
sentences.zh: 这让它显得更有冲击力。

sentences.en: And then Rashida, oh, my gosh, her reaction is so perfect.
sentences.zh: 然后拉什达，天哪，她的反应太完美了。

sentences.en: It's a fantastic scene.
sentences.zh: 这是一场精彩的戏。

sentences.en: Fantastic scene.
sentences.zh: 精彩的戏。

sentences.en: I feel like her pulse stops for a second.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她的脉搏停了一秒。

sentences.en: Like, I feel like I can see the wind go out of her, right?
sentences.zh: 就像，我觉得我能看到她泄了气一样，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, I do, too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也是。

sentences.en: You just, you see it hit her like a freight train, but she can't react.
sentences.zh: 你就是能看到它像货运列车一样撞向她，但她却无法做出反应。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The way it's really hitting her.
sentences.zh: 那种真正冲击她的方式。

sentences.en: It's so well done.
sentences.zh: 做得太好了。

sentences.en: These ladies did such a great job.
sentences.zh: 这两位女士表现得太棒了。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, Andy is the first person to actually get back to the office.
sentences.zh: 安迪是第一个回到办公室的人。

sentences.en: And he starts, he starts sneaking around Dwight's desk.
sentences.zh: 他开始在德怀特的办公桌周围鬼鬼祟祟地摸索。

sentences.en: He goes through his car.
sentences.zh: 他翻了他的车。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Andy is a total snake.
sentences.zh: 安迪真是个彻头彻尾的阴险小人。

sentences.en: I mean, what the heck?
sentences.zh: 我是说，搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And he finds this toll booth receipt that proves that Dwight was in New York this morning.
sentences.zh: 他发现了一张过路费收据，证明德怀特今天早上在纽约。

sentences.en: He didn't oversleep like he claimed.
sentences.zh: 他并没有像他声称的那样睡过头。

sentences.en: And he marches into Michael's office.
sentences.zh: 然后他大步走进迈克尔的办公室。

sentences.en: And he's like, I found this toll booth receipt.
sentences.zh: 他说，我发现了这张过路费收据。

sentences.en: I wonder what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他在做什么。

sentences.en: Was he, maybe he was talking to Jan.
sentences.zh: 他是不是，也许他是在和简谈话。

sentences.en: And then he says, like, I seem to kind of remember.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我好像记得。

sentences.en: I don't know who told me this, even though, Jenna, this was like, like an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是谁告诉我的，尽管，珍娜，这明明就是一小时前的事。

sentences.en: He's like, I don't know who told me this.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道是谁告诉我的。

sentences.en: It was something.
sentences.zh: 那真是一段经历。

sentences.en: And then he has maybe one of my favorite quotes of this episode.
sentences.zh: 然后他说出了这一集里我最喜欢的台词之一。

sentences.en: He was like, there's a story.
sentences.zh: 他说，这背后有个故事。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It was about laundry and betrayal.
sentences.zh: 是关于洗衣服和背叛的故事。

sentences.en: In my mind, this is now a lifetime movie called Laundry and Betrayal.
sentences.zh: 在我脑海里，这已经是一部叫《洗衣服与背叛》的电视电影了。

sentences.en: I want to see it.
sentences.zh: 我想看这部电影。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Laundry and Betrayal.
sentences.zh: 《洗衣服与背叛》。

sentences.en: I want to see this film.
sentences.zh: 我想看这部电影。

sentences.en: I do, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Well, so Michael calls Jan.
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔给简打了电话。

sentences.en: And Jan is like, well, I didn't speak to Dwight.
sentences.zh: 简说，我没跟德怀特谈过。

sentences.en: But he did not give a reason for why he was here.
sentences.zh: 但他没说他为什么去那儿。

sentences.en: Yes.
